title: Add Open WebUI auth bootstrap and operator attention event
invariants: LOGIN_REQUIRED emits at most one required event per run
auth-bootstrap and acceptance reuse the same profile
credential entry has no acceptance evidence capture
successful authentication resumes the original acceptance
timeout or cancellation submits no prompt
operator attention is an event producer, not a Notifier transport
reload_boundaries: reopen the same persistent profile after authentication
remaining_unproven: live GPU placement and receipt correlation
future_notifier_boundary: Notifier channels consume the operational attention event; no delivery transport is implemented here.
